verdict.rationale: Ashby exposes a full REST API (create/update candidates, list with cursors and sync tokens), webhooks for event-driven automation, and an MCP server for programmatic/agent access, all of which support headless, non-UI automation flows outside the app. However, there is no explicit CI tooling, CLI, SDK, or documented CI/CD pipeline integration pattern — the evidence centers on ad-hoc API/webhook usage rather than a first-class 'run in CI' story. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or SDK, explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), and independent confirmation of headless automation reliability.
